item.title: Meridian Semiconductor to build $4.2 billion packaging plant in Arizona
item.description: Meridian Semiconductor said the plant will cost $4.2 billion and employ 1,800 people when it opens in 2029. Construction begins in the first quarter. State officials said incentives were part of the agreement.

item.title: Meridian confirms Arizona advanced packaging site, 1,800 jobs promised
item.description: The company confirmed the Arizona site on Wednesday and said it expects 1,800 jobs. Meridian put the investment at $4.2 billion. The facility is scheduled to open in 2029.

item.title: Meridian's Arizona packaging plant listed at $3.8 billion in state filing
item.description: A state filing reviewed on Thursday lists Meridian Semiconductor's Arizona packaging plant at $3.8 billion, not the $4.2 billion the company announced. Meridian did not respond to a request for comment on the discrepancy.

item.title: Grid operator warns data-centre demand could add 6 gigawatts by 2030
item.description: The regional grid operator said data-centre load could add 6 gigawatts of demand by 2030 under its high-growth scenario. The operator said transmission upgrades would be needed. No decision has been taken on cost allocation.

item.title: Data-centre growth pushes regional grid planners toward transmission upgrades
item.description: Planners said the 6 gigawatt high-growth figure assumes current expansion announcements are completed on schedule. Utilities have asked regulators to clarify who pays for the upgrades.
